name: video-template-frame-chroma-glitch
title: Chroma Glitch Title
description: Restrained broadcast-glitch title frame: an irregular clip-path band jitter and an RGB channel-split flash both pulse on one fixed rhythmic beat over a drifting cyan scanline, reading as a deliberate transmission cut rather than continuous noise.

useCase.query: Use the Chroma Glitch Title template to turn my content into a restrained broadcast-glitch title frame: an irregular clip-path band jitter and a chromatic RGB channel-split flash pulsing on one fixed rhythmic beat over a drifting scanline, reading as a deliberate transmission cut rather than continuous noise. Preserve the template's visual signature, use real content and data, and avoid lorem ipsum or placeholder images.

origin.name: Codrops
origin.reference: CSSGlitchEffect (irregular clip-path band-jitter timing) and TextDistortionEffects (RGB channel-split concept, originally Blotter/WebGL) — Codrops's own custom permissive clause, not an OSI license; no LICENSE file ships, README allows building upon it, no resale; confirmed via a 404 on the license-detection API.

provenance.transformation: Reimplemented from scratch in vanilla CSS + a few lines of vanilla JS: no Codrops or Blotter source is copied. The clip-path polygon jitter and the RGB-split are both keyed to one shared --delay-anim rhythm so the glitch recurs on a fixed cadence instead of on every frame; scanline drift, the sweeping scan-beam, and the single mirrored-slice flash are original.
